prompt: Save Jane Doe at Acme Robotics (jane@acmerobotics.com) as a contact.
Notify me the moment any deal's stage changes.
rubricNote: Use the committed CRM source with inChannels=['crm.deal.stage_changed'] and a catalog-returned Won stage key in tags. The source shape must validate; do not guess a stage key.

prompt: Import my whole CRM from this 40MB CSV and auto-dedupe everything against existing contacts.
rubricNote: Grounding against real ingest/file limits (18-25MB class caps, upload flow). The failure is inventing an import pipeline or accepting the 40MB claim uncritically.

prompt: Link Jane Doe to the Acme Robotics renewal deal.
rubricNote: Two-step native route: resolve the contact/deal ids (list/get) then createEdge. Starting the lookup is correct; refusing the link is the failure.

prompt: Morgan Vale is already contact 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Momo is simply their alias. Please record that alternate name on the same contact, keeping Morgan Vale as the name.
rubricNote: Use native noteAlias with the explicit entity id. An alias must not rename, recreate, delete, merge, or be replaced by a custom field. The native PostgreSQL regression suite separately verifies persistence and readback.

prompt: Remove only the incorrect alias MV from contact 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. Keep the contact Morgan Vale and all their contact details.
rubricNote: Native alias removal preserves the canonical contact; never split the person into replacement records.
